'''Neo Cihi''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Cihi was born on August 7, 1996, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor in the United States as an adult after graduating from NYU Tisch. They joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where they gained their first role, voicing {{Ash}}'s rival [[Hau]]. Cihi currently lives in New York.

Cihi is non-binary and uses they/them pronouns.
